games.title: Cow Abductors
games.subtitle: 3D UFO Farm Heist
games.description: Pilot a UFO over a night farm, abduct cows with your tractor beam, dodge the angry farmer, and beat the clock. Combos, powerups, and three difficulty tiers.

games.title: VOID BLASTER
games.subtitle: Alien Invasion — Hold the Line
games.description: Four rows of alien invaders descend on your planet. Blast them before they reach you. Destroy the mystery ship for bonus points. Three lives. No mercy.

games.title: ASTEROID DRIFT
games.subtitle: Vector Space. Survive.
games.description: Your ship drifts through a debris field. Rotate, thrust, and blast. Rocks split. Smaller fragments move faster. Use hyperspace when cornered — if you dare.

games.title: NEON SNAKE
games.subtitle: Glow Trails. Speed Ramp.
games.description: Classic snake with phosphor glow trails. Eat food, grow longer, move faster. Every five pickups the multiplier climbs. High score saves locally.
